links.label: Looma GitHub/MIT setup
links.promptSummary: Move Looma toward public GitHub/MIT/npm readiness, preserving history and avoiding npm publish without approval.
links.resultSummary: Codex worker Herschel prepared Looma public GitHub/MIT metadata in an isolated worktree, pushed initial main to github.com/threadlabs-studio/looma at commit ecf731986d17e2ed0e2115dcafd2ba96e9fa1c70, left Bitbucket origin unchanged, documented npm package naming, and found release blockers in @looma/core build/typecheck/test plus invalid npm auth.
